script_state_setter.name: SceneScript_AdvanceState
script_state_setter.behavior: Consumes scene-script words from SCENE_SCRIPT_CURSOR and stores the next state byte in SCENE_STATE when a terminator record is reached.

resource_dispatcher.name: SceneResource_Dispatch
resource_dispatcher.behavior: Selects state-specific resource/event work, then performs the common VDP/resource rebuild. State 0x08 reaches the common path and is also tested by the player transition handler.

player_transition_handler.behavior: Branches on SCENE_STATE == 0x08 before normal player integration, providing the camera/transition path.

scene_script_completion.behavior: When a pending scene script reaches its terminator, sets SCENE_STATE to 0x01 and rebuilds the active scene.

scene_table_selector.behavior: Advances SCENE_TABLE_INDEX, loads a script pointer from the ROM scene table, and loads the entry state byte.

state_zero_reset.behavior: Reinitializes the scene system and explicitly sets SCENE_STATE to 0x00.

vdp_clear.behavior: Clears the transition VDP pattern/name-table regions used by the common scene rebuild.

limitations: The captured title-to-first-level run did not reach a level-exit trigger, so no dynamic state-0x08 write is claimed yet.
The scene-table ROM entries are identified statically by their use at 0x001B3B96; entry-to-level names still require a targeted exit or level-selection experiment.
